origin: new replay of supplied checkpoint; not extracted from old video

information_contract.state_sensor: exact q, v, aggregate constraint-force port at control decisions
information_contract.inference: known robot geometry; causal original-state history; optional delayed noisy geometry rays
information_contract.estimator: fixed-parameter local quadratic Kalman filter and gated contact-force inverse
information_contract.calibration_labels: shared q/v/acceleration/aggregate force labels; new presets fit contact ports without per-contact labels

learned_pH.integrator: semi-implicit Euler of learned force model
learned_pH.information: current raw state, estimated scan/friction, previous action, current force port

learned_pH_truth_environment.integrator: semi-implicit Euler of learned force model
learned_pH_truth_environment.information: current raw state, estimated scan/friction, previous action, current force port
learned_pH_truth_environment.access: audit-only exact current terrain samples and root-location friction; model weights unchanged

instantaneous_model_diagnostics.interpretation: one local operating point; force/drift norms combine translational and rotational coordinates

replay_audit_only.access: compiled full model and integration state; never an ordinary policy input
